messages:
maya_sales: Quick heads-up — FinTech POC needs a lower per-token hosted rate for a 90-day evaluation. Current catalog rate for the model they want is $0.03 / 1k tokens. They asked for $0.012 / 1k up to 50M tokens. Need deal-desk sign-off by EOD to keep the demo next week.

alex_se: What model + token profile? streaming vs sync? also latency SLO?

maya_sales: They want to use redwood/open-medu-20b v1. Estimated ~30M tokens over 90d, but bursty during integration tests. Latency not a blocker, target p50 < 500ms. No regulated PII expected for POC; security questionnaire inbound.

alex_se: OK numbers: 50M * $0.012/1k = ~$600 exposure. Are they willing to sign a short commit or PO?

sam_dealdesk: We need a short justification doc: scope, max exposure, timeframe. Our preferred route is a transient credit + standard rates. Example: $5k credit + 25% off hosted for 90d. That keeps billing simple.

maya_sales: Procurement will only accept a line-item rate on the invoice, not a one-off credit. They insist on a per-token override for the POC period so accounting can map to a budget line.

jordan_sec: Security note: they require EU data residency for models used in POC. Also sent back the security questionnaire — responses in my thread. No KMS/HSM required for POC but call that out.

alex_se: Operationally we can apply a temporary rate override scoped to the org for a fixed window + token cap. Example internal call:

```http
PATCH /orgs/{org_id}/billing/overrides
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "scope": "org",
  "meter": "token",
  "rate_per_1k": 0.012,
  "limit_tokens": 50000000,
  "expires_at": "2026-06-07T23:59:59Z",
  "note": "POC - FinTech - temporary rate for demo"
}
```

alex_se: That will auto-revert at expiry. We can also add an absolute dollar cap to cut risk.

sam_dealdesk: If we go that route, conditions: (1) signed SOW + PO on file before override, (2) explicit dollar cap (suggest $800), (3) auto-revert at expiry, (4) finance must ack the collection risk. @fin_ops / finance team need to sign off.

billing-bot: Reminder: override requests require `deal_id` and `approver` metadata. See: https://redwood.internal/billing/overrides (internal).

maya_sales: I'll upload SOW and PO today and push the SQ completion. Can Sam provisionally approve an override with a $800 cap and 90d expiry so I can promise the customer?

sam_dealdesk: Provisional approval granted with those exact constraints: $800 hard cap, expires in 90d, requires SOW + PO + completed SQ. Final approval after finance confirms. I'll add the ticket to the deal-desk queue and block any billing changes until docs are attached.

maya_sales: Great — will attach docs and loop in finance now. Appreciate the fast turnaround :raised_hands:
